units.source_text: 可是，两位武士觉得自己吃了这个身份低下的樵夫的闷亏，内心羡慕嫉妒演变成了仇恨。

en.t: But the two warriors felt they had been made fools of by this lowly woodcutter, and their envy and jealousy turned into hatred.

units.source_text: 他们内心充满怨恨，表面上却装作十分欢喜，

en.t: Their hearts were filled with resentment, yet outwardly they pretended to be very pleased,

units.source_text: 不断赞美发长彦的功劳，终于了解了三条狗的来历和腰间魔笛的奇妙之处。

en.t: continually praising Hatsunagahiko's achievements until at last they learned the origins of the three dogs and the wondrous nature of the magic flute at his waist.

units.source_text: 他们趁发长彦不备，抢下了他的别在腰间的笛子，

en.t: They seized the moment when Hatsunagahiko was off guard and snatched the flute tucked at his waist,

units.source_text: 再快速骑到黑狗背上，抱着两只狗和两位公主，

en.t: then quickly mounted the black dog's back, carrying the two dogs and the two princesses,

units.source_text: 大声叫道：“阿飞，阿飞，飞往京城飞鸟国大臣的府邸。”

en.t: and cried out loudly, "Fly, fly, fly to the mansion of the minister of Asuka Province in the capital."
